notes.title: Worlds 1-3 Playtest Begins!
notes.content: [p]Thank you to everyone who signed up for our [i]Snogbert [/i]Worlds 1-3[i] [/i]playtest! [/p][p]If you registered to take part, you're now able to install and play the game from your Steam library! [/p][p]This playtest includes Worlds 1, 2, and 3 as well as a feedback form. Make sure and submit the form (at least the "About You" section) so that we can have your name to properly credit you. [/p][p][/p][p]If the game [b]wasn't[/b] automatically added to your library, check the email inbox attached to your account for a confirmation from Steam with the subject "You've been invited to help test Snogbert".[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again to all testers! We look forward to hearing what you think of [i]Snogbert[/i]![/p][p][/p][p]This round of playtesting will be active until 10/13/2025. We hope you'll support us in Steam Next Fest starting that same day. [/p][p]And if you missed out this time, please look forward to announcements about more opportunities to play [i]Snogbert[/i] in the future![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635975/66e77b468941533b6608f7749740968991563b2e.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo V2 Released!
notes.content: [p]Thank you for over 800 demo plays this month! Eight HUNDRED of you spent time with our little guy, and we're grateful for it![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635975/5b23d5911f257ba65377129bb3c9e03b19eba319.gif"][/img][/p][p]Thank you all for your support![/p][p]And thank you again to everyone who sent us bug reports. This update should address those issues and more.[/p][p]This patch includes:[/p][list][*][p]Title music! It's a WIP track, but we were so excited for you all to hear it that it's made it into the demo :)[/p][/*][*][p]Difficulty updates to some missions in World 2: Crystal Caverns. [/p][/*][*][p]Collision updates for nearly everything. Most notably to moving platforms, bottomless pits, Snogbert's doors, D6s' doors, and invisible doors.[/p][/*][*][p]Loading optimization--the level should now load faster and wait for everything in it to be loaded before it starts. [/p][/*][*][p]Updated music for World 2: Crystal Caverns.[/p][/*][*][p]Patched bug where D8s would take damage immediately if spawning near another enemy.[/p][/*][*][p]Patched bug where a D8's Arrow would never despawn if it was shot out-of-bounds.[/p][/*][*][p]Patched bug where a D8's Arrow was invincible while being spawned and aimed.[/p][/*][*][p]Patched bug where player jumping (from the ground) while running into a wall would use their wall jump.[/p][/*][*][p]Patched bug where Pause Screen would only capture mouse input.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor visual updates around World 1: Brick Bunker.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor visual updates to moving platforms.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor lighting updates.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor in-game UI updates.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed [i]Snogbert 2022[/i] logo apparition.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Itching for more [i]Snogbert[/i]? Look forward to rolling with us in next month's Steam Next Fest and into Early Access soon after! Until then, stay Snoggy![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635975/d8ab8f1a643eeca22619206b7d1ab898f473d504.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Playtest Invites Open Now!
notes.content: [p]We’re looking for gamers to take on Worlds 1-3 of [i]Snogbert[/i] this month! If you’re reading this, it could be you![/p][p]Want to play an all-new indie game and get your [b]name in the credits[/b]?[/p][p][/p][p]Sign up NOW at the link on our Steam page, or email [url="https://snogbertdevs@gmail.com"]snogbertdevs@gmail.com[/url] ![/p][p][/p][p]Note: Playtest is Windows-only (sorry MacOS & Linux users, we're figuring it out).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635975/9ebb59abe92150d7c00fcaa0823b86ce99c7110d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Released!
notes.content: [p]Snogbert's Demo is out NOW for Windows users! [/p][p]Put your puzzle platforming to the test in this sample of the all-new arcade roguelike![/p][p][/p][p]This demo includes all 10 levels of World 1: Brick Bunker and 5 levels from World 2: Crystal Caverns. These feature 8 random missions to be explored.[/p][p][/p][p]We'll keep this demo updated as progress is made on the full game, so stay tuned for more "Snogress"![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45635975/e70c2712f7021b694d8416dc67e651200bc09f40.png"][/img][/p]
